title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Several small structures face a wooden bridge of weathered planks, sunbleached to a pale grey, and the wildflower-covered island it connects to.  Colonies of monk's-hood lichen gather along the base of the bridge, spreading across debarked logs scattered near the pond's edge.  Large ceramic frogs, some dressed in enameled waistcoats and others sporting gold-glazed monocles, are whimsically posed atop the various logs.
